T1S-001.alteredFlavorText:
"I believe this is only the prologue of my story."
—Doran

T1S-002.alteredFlavorText:
"Relax, I will carry you to victory."
—Oner

T1S-003.alteredFlavorText: "I have watched the rise and fall of many teams, but the player who stood at the end was always me." —Faker

T1S-004.alteredFlavorText: "Now I can say it out loud: I am the best AD carry in the world." —Gumayusi

T1S-005.alteredFlavorText: "Feel free to look up to me—just don't think it will be easy to follow." —Keria

VEN-019a.alteredFlavorText: "What? Do I have someone in my teeth?"

VEN-138a.baseCardName: Shen, Leader of the Kinkou Order

VEN-167.alteredFlavorText: "I like you as far as I can throw you ... not even."

VEN-169.alteredFlavorText: "Challenge me, Shen ... You shall not be an orphan long!"

VEN-170.alteredFlavorText: "You're already dead. You just haven't caught up yet."

VEN-173.alteredFlavorText: "Am I to seek revenge for my poor deparated arm? If anything, girl, you did me a favor."

VEN-174.alteredFlavorText: "Did you wanna lose the other one too?"

VEN-178.alteredFlavorText: "Rage burned away all that was good in you, my brother."

VEN-179.alteredFlavorText: A hunter to test the fiercest prey.

VEN-180.alteredFlavorText: A predator to challenge the keenest foe.

VEN-182.baseCardName: Illaoi, Prophet of the Great Kraken
VEN-182.alteredFlavorText: "I broke men's hearts. I broke men's spines. You're the first who's going to get both."

VEN-183.alteredFlavorText:
Their dearest wish is to share a sky
Made large enough for both to dance
With hands and hearts entwined
—Hymn of the Dawn

VEN-184.alteredFlavorText:
Instead they must steal glances
Wait for the other to approach
Or watch the other depart
—Hymn of the Dawn

VEN-186.alteredFlavorText: "Mother must be so proud of all your murders, Kayle."

VEN-187.alteredFlavorText: "Have you finally realized your potential, Mel?"

VEN-188.alteredFlavorText: "I deserve everything I've attained; I know that now."

UNL-029a.alteredFlavorText: "You said the only things in this valley were lizards!"

UNL-220.alteredFlavorText:
There will be winds we cannot face
And cold that reaches to our bone

UNL-221.alteredFlavorText:
We may have fallen out of gracce
We may feel we are all alone

UNL-222.alteredFlavorText:
But dreams are brighter than we know
And shine like gold to lead us home

UNL-223.alteredFlavorText:
As others know when we've been strong
So others strive to be enough

UNL-224.alteredFlavorText:
Now let us find the strength in song
And let it raise our hearts aloft

UNL-225.alteredFlavorText:
We rush to meet the rising dawn
And may it lead us to our fluft
